description: CLM-8B (Contrastive Language Model) Action Caching Empirical Verification

favorable_scenarios: Fixed Action Space Intent Classification (massive-en-US): Cold 0.0% (266.5ms) -> Action Cached 44.0% (98.1ms, 2.7x speedup)
High-Frequency Tick Policy (Rocket League 3v3 tick): Cold 808.4ms -> Action Cached 115.6ms (7.0x speedup)
Declarative Action Reframing (Fairy Tale Deception): Legacy keyword-trapped 30.8% -> Reframed Cached Actions 84.6%
unfavorable_scenarios: Tri-State Epistemic Ambiguity: Softmax with large scaling parameter collapses uncertain probability to 11.4% (85.9% polarized to Impossible)
Long-Context Information Retrieval (Phase 2): Mean-pooled Bi-Encoder dilutes localized clauses, achieving only 40.0% (13/15 defaulted to False)

massive_en_US_60_intents.observation: Removing dictionary string serialization noise and pre-encoding the 60 intent embeddings enabled 44% accuracy with sub-100ms response.

rocket_league_agent_tick.observation: Action caching turns 8B LLM inference into a single state-encoding pass followed by 12 vector dot products, enabling real-time game tick loop.

fairy_tale_deception_boundary.observation: Formulating choices as explicit declarative behavioral assertions ('Wolf disguises itself to deceive') overcomes surface word association traps.

tri_state_epistemic_collapse.observation: Contrastive logit scaling (alpha approx 100) polarizes probabilities, crushing nuanced uncertainty into near-zero confidence.

long_context_contract_extraction.observation: Bi-encoder sentence pooling averages 2,000+ tokens, diluting specific contract clauses. 13 out of 15 queries defaulted to False.
